key_insight: Two-level overlapping Schwarz preconditioners with GDSW and RGDSW coarse spaces remain robust for high-order 2D FEM/VEM Poisson discretizations, while RGDSW significantly shrinks the coarse problem.
engineering_relevance: This enables scalable iterative solvers for high-order finite element and virtual element simulations by preserving convergence as polynomial degree increases.
method: Build two-level additive Schwarz preconditioners with overlapping subdomains and either GDSW or reduced GDSW coarse spaces.
Analyze conforming P_k and Q_k discretizations with a condition number bound that shows explicit dependence on polynomial degree k.
Validate on structured triangular/quadrilateral FEM meshes and polygonal VEM meshes for the 2D Poisson problem.
evidence_signal: Numerical experiments up to polynomial order k=9 show scalable behavior for both coarse spaces, with RGDSW reducing coarse dimension by about 3x while keeping competitive iteration counts.
watch_item: The reported robustness is demonstrated for 2D Poisson problems, so performance on more complex PDEs, higher dimensions, or highly heterogeneous coefficients may require additional verification.
paper_title: Two-level additive Schwarz preconditioners with GDSW coarse spaces for high-order discretizations in 2D
